title: Italo's short story in which the ET plays 'the universal' chess game
summary: Italo Venturelli tells of Italo's short story in which the ET plays 'the universal' chess game, about recent at Varginha, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In order to talk about this, I wrote a short story. How could I examine the ET if I didn't have a CT scan? if I didn't have anything. So, it's a chess game called the universal,

plain: Italo Venturelli, a surgeon connected to a story about an alien being treated at a hospital in Varginha, Brazil, says he wrote a short story to talk about it. He explains that he could not have examined the ET, his word for an extraterrestrial, without a CT scan, a hospital body scanner, so he told it instead as a chess game called "the universal." He mentions a man named Adriano Caldier, and the story is his way of speaking about something he says he could not describe directly.
